measures.title: Creation of a hospital district and a tax of up to 75 cents per $100 valuation
measures.summary: The ballot states: "THIS IS A TAX INCREASE." It asks voters to approve creating a hospital district and levying a tax of not more than 75 cents on each $100 of taxable value of property taxable by the district.
measures.yesMeans: The hospital district is created and may levy a property tax of up to 75 cents per $100 of taxable value.
measures.noMeans: The hospital district is not created and the tax is not levied.

measures.title: Moving Regular City Elections to November
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to move regular elections for mayor and all council members to the November uniform election date in odd-numbered years, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: Regular city elections move to the November uniform election date in odd-numbered years.
measures.noMeans: Regular city election dates stay as they are under the current charter.

measures.title: Repealing the Resign-to-Run Provision
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to repeal the requirement that a City Council member resign and vacate the seat upon filing to run for a different office on the City Council, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: Council members would no longer have to resign to run for a different City Council office.
measures.noMeans: The resign-to-run requirement stays in the charter.

measures.title: Filling Vacancies on the City Council
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to require that any City Council vacancy be filled by majority vote of the remaining council members, with a special election allowed if the council no longer has a quorum, plus related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: Council vacancies would be filled by majority vote of the remaining members, with a special election if there is no quorum.
measures.noMeans: The current charter process for filling council vacancies stays in place.

measures.title: Initiative & Referendum Petition Timeline
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to change, from 10 days to 30 days, the time the City Secretary has to certify an initiative or referendum petition and the time a petitioner has to amend a deficient petition, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: The petition certification and amendment periods change from 10 days to 30 days.

measures.title: Adoption of Initiatives
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to prohibit the City Council from adopting, or submitting to voters, any initiated ordinance that is inconsistent with state law, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: The council could not adopt or submit to voters an initiated ordinance inconsistent with state law.
measures.noMeans: The charter is not amended on this point.

measures.title: Grounds for Recall
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to require that a recall affidavit allege incompetence, official misconduct, or malfeasance in office by the elected official, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: A recall affidavit would have to allege incompetence, official misconduct, or malfeasance in office.
measures.noMeans: The charter's current recall grounds stay in place.

measures.title: Recall Petition Requirements
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to change, from 1 day to 5 days, the time the City Secretary has to provide petition blanks after a recall affidavit is submitted, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: The City Secretary would have 5 days instead of 1 day to provide recall petition blanks.

measures.title: Recall of District Councilmember
measures.summary: Would amend the Killeen City Charter to require that a person filing a recall affidavit for a district council member live within that member's district, with related grammatical and technical changes.
measures.yesMeans: Only residents of a district council member's district could file a recall affidavit against that member.
measures.noMeans: The charter is not amended on this point.
